verdict.rationale: Release-cadence transparency applies to any shipped software. However, the pack shows only versioned feature announcements (0.3.0 and 0.3.5 blog posts) and an API changelog of endpoint additions. Nothing documents bug-fix or security-patch releases, advisories, or response times, so a developer cannot judge how quickly critical issues are fixed.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how quickly the project ships patches for critical bugs and security vulnerabilities based on its public release history
